# A shelf for useful failures

Kept the cracked bowl, the pinched mug and the sleeve repair on one shelf for a week. They each show a different sort of failure, but only the first two look like failures from across the room. A visitor asked about the careful stitches. [[Pottery]]: a repair can reveal attention without turning damage into an inspirational story.
